name: Bihar
intro: Where the Buddha found enlightenment and Mahavira was born: Bodh Gaya, Nalanda, Rajgir and Vaishali, Mauryan Pataliputra, Sher Shah's Sasaram, Mithila's painters and the Ganga's river dolphins.

trails.name: The Buddhist circuit
trails.note: Enlightenment at Bodh Gaya, sermons at Rajgir, learning at Nalanda, last journeys at Vaishali and Kesaria.

trails.name: Patna in a day
trails.note: Mauryan ruins, a beehive granary, two great museums and the Ganga at dusk.

trails.name: Rajgir and Nalanda
trails.note: Hills, hot springs and the ruins of the world's most famous ancient university.

trails.name: Jain Bihar
trails.note: Places tied to the life of Mahavira.

trails.name: Sher Shah country
trails.note: Sher Shah's lake tomb, a giant hill fort and the Kaimur's monsoon falls.

trails.name: Champaran
trails.note: Gandhi's first satyagraha, Ashokan pillars and Bihar's tiger reserve.

trails.name: Mithila
trails.note: Painting villages, palaces of the Darbhanga raj and Sita's birthplace.

trails.name: Down the Ganga
trails.note: Forts, yoga, river dolphins and silk along Bihar's eastern Ganga.

trails.name: Mithila
trails.note: Maithil temples, palaces and painting villages of north Bihar.

trails.name: Shahabad and the Kaimur
trails.note: 1857 heroes, Sher Shah's forts and cave shrines of southwest Bihar.
